jobs.title: Upper Division Clerk
jobs.company: Office of the Collector, North Goa
jobs.qualification: Essential: 1. Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university. 2. One year experience in administrative work. 3. Minimum 6 months certificate course in computer. 4. Knowledge of Konkani. Desirable: Knowledge of Marathi.
jobs.description: Group 'C' post under Collectorate of North Goa. Age limit: Not exceeding 45 years (relaxable up to 5 years for government servants and employees of office of Administrator of Comunidades).

jobs.title: Lower Division Clerk
jobs.company: Office of the Collector, North & South Goa
jobs.qualification: Essential: 1. Higher Secondary School Certificate from a recognized Board or AICTE approved State Board of Technical Education or equivalent. 2. Knowledge of computer with typing speed of 30 words per minute in English. 3. At-least one year working experience. 4. Knowledge of Konkani. Desirable: Knowledge of Marathi.
jobs.description: Group 'C' post under Collectorate of North Goa (33 posts) and Collectorate of South Goa (41 posts). Age limit: Not exceeding 45 years (relaxable up to 5 years for government servants and employees of office of Administrator of Comunidades).

jobs.title: Multi Tasking Staff
jobs.company: Office of the Collector, North & South Goa
jobs.qualification: Essential: 1. Secondary School Certificate from a recognized Board/Institution OR Certificate course conducted by ITI in relevant trade. 2. At-least one year working experience. 3. Knowledge of Konkani. Desirable: i) Knowledge of Marathi ii) Knowledge of operating office machines including computers.
jobs.description: Group 'C' post under Collectorate of North Goa (4 posts) and Collectorate of South Goa (5 posts).
